get.description:
***
The GraphQl query for this endpoint is:
``` graphql
query app($miniappId: String!, $limit: Int! = 20, $offset: Int! = 0) {
  sources(where: {miniapp_id: {_eq: $miniappId}}, order_by: {recorded_at: desc}, limit: $limit, offset: $offset) {
    miniapp_id
    source_type
    recorded_at
    features_haptics
    features_camera_and_microphone_access
    client_miniapp_platform_type
    client_farcaster_id
    user {
      farcaster_id
      username
      displayName
      pfpUrl
    }
  }
}
```
